unit.why: A single anecdote: the Besht sees a demon carrying a book of his own teachings, discovers the disciple who wrote them down, and rejects the writings.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרב דקהלתינו פ"א כתב איש
stories.end_quote: אין כאן אפילו דבור אחד שאמרתי
stories.summary_en: The Besht sees a demon carrying a book that 'you composed', learns that a man has been writing down his teachings, gathers his followers, and on reading the man's notes declares that not one word in them is what he said.

quotes: ראה הבעש״ט ששד א׳ הולך ואוחז ספר בידו
tags.why: A demon carries the book and speaks with the Besht.

quotes: אמר לו מה זה הספר שבידך
tags.why: The Besht converses with a demon.

quotes: אז הבין הבעש״ט שיש איש אחד שכותב תורתו
tags.why: He learns of the secret writing by supernatural means.
He sees a demon while awake.

quotes: והביא לו כתבים ועיין בהם הבעש״ט
tags.why: The plot turns on hidden written copies of the master's teachings.
The Besht confronts his disciples over the transmission of his teaching.
The story concerns the transmission of the Besht's Torah discourses.

quotes: אין כאן אפילו דבור אחד שאמרתי
